units.source_text: “听见了吗……清沙的确是要紧事……

en.t: Do you hear me? Clearing away the sand is certainly important...
But that is a means, not the goal...

units.source_text: 目的该是想法从沙的威胁下保护自己的生活……

en.t: The goal should be to find a way to protect one's own life from the threat of the sand...

units.source_text: 幸亏我对沙子多少还有些研究，特别有兴趣，所以我才特地跑来这里。

en.t: Fortunately, I have done some research on sand and have a particular interest in it, which is why I came all the way here.

units.source_text: 说起来嘛，沙子把现代人吸引住了，

en.t: When you think about it, sand has captured the attention of modern people,

units.source_text: 它具有不可思议的魅力啊……
可以想办法利用这一点……

en.t: We could find a way to make use of that...

units.source_text: 把这儿作为新的观光胜地来开发……

en.t: Develop this place as a new sightseeing destination...

units.source_text: 不是与沙子唱反调，而是顺应沙子的特点，利用它……

en.t: Instead of working against the sand, we should adapt to its nature and make use of it...

units.source_text: 也就是说，要下狠心转换一下脑筋……”

en.t: In other words, we have to make up our minds and change the way we think..."
